rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice To Motion And Motion For Judgment Pursuant To Settlement Agreement And Stipulation Filed By Plaintiff Burke Lewis Apartments, Lp, Against Defendant Brad Chapin
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for September 11, 2026. Line 11. PLAINTIFF BURKE LEWIS APARTMENTS, LP Notice To Motion And Motion For Judgment Pursuant To Settlement Agreement And Stipulation Filed By Plaintiff Burke Lewis Apartments, Lp, Against Defendant Brad Chapin is DENIED without prejudice. No competent evidence of breach. Defendant's obligation under the Stipulation is to apply for rent relief and to use best efforts to obtain full rent relief. Plaintiff identifies no provision of the Stipulation which specifically obligates Defendant to secure approval of a rent relief application, either by any particular date, or ever. Supporting declaration stating that Plaintiff has not been contacted by any rent relief organization seeking to pay Defendant's rental debt indicates only that Defendant has not been approved for rent relief. No evidence that Defendant failed to apply or to use best efforts. =(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849).
